description: Manage Focus → Project → Outcome hierarchy + calendar in MIND Life. Items are either projects (top-level domain/client buckets that live inside a Focus) or outcomes (deliverables that live under a parent project). Use `item_type` + `parent_id` + `focus_id` on create/update to wire the hierarchy. Use list filters (item_type, parent_id, focus_id, top_level_only) to slice the board. Share a project with another MIND account using share/list_shares/revoke_share (requires LIFE_SHARING_ENABLED on the backend; grantee gets the project + its outcomes on their board).

action.description: What to do: list/create/update/complete/delete/bulk_delete/move/get items, calendar_list/calendar_create/calendar_update/calendar_delete events, stats (productivity overview), share (grant another MIND account access to a project) / list_shares (who a project is shared with) / revoke_share (drop a grant)

agent_ids.description: Agents bound to this project (project only). On update, REPLACES the existing list.

all_day.description: Whether the calendar event is all-day

color.description: Left-border color stripe on the board card. Use to group items (e.g. Astra=red, Atlas=blue).

focus_id.description: For projects — the focus_id this project belongs to. Pass empty string on update to detach (No Focus). On list, pass a focus_id to filter to that focus, or 'none' for unfiled projects.

grantee_username.description: Username to grant access to (action=share). Must be an existing MIND account.

include_completed.description: On list — false hides completed items. Defaults true.

item_ids.description: Item IDs for bulk_delete (1–200 IDs deleted in one call)

item_type.description: 'project' (top-level domain/client bucket; lives inside a Focus) or 'outcome' (deliverable under a parent project). Defaults to 'outcome' on create. Pass on list to filter.

limit.description: On list — max items to return (1–500, default 30).

parent_id.description: For outcomes — the item_id of the parent project. Pass empty string on update to detach (make top-level). On list, pass an item_id to fetch its outcomes, or 'none' for items with no parent.

share_id.description: Share-grant id to revoke (action=revoke_share). Get it from action=list_shares.

share_role.description: Role for the grant (action=share). 'owner' = full control over the project + its outcomes. 'viewer' = read-only. Default: viewer.

status.description: Status filter for list, or new status for update (e.g. action, someday, waiting, completed)

tags.description: Tags for the life item (free-form strings). On update, REPLACES the existing tag list — pass the full new set.

target_date.description: Target completion date in YYYY-MM-DD format — when the project should be done. Powers the countdown badge on the card.

title.description: Title for new items or calendar events

top_level_only.description: On list — true returns only items with no parent (board roots: projects + unassigned outcomes).

workflow_ids.description: Workflows bound to this project (project only). On update, REPLACES the existing list.

name: mind_life
